description:
Tobit Laboratories AG TeamDavid's Webbox application is vulnerable to a stored XSS vulnerability. An 
attacker can send an email containing malicious JavaScript code. When a 
user accesses the email, the stored cross-site scripting is triggered. This issue affects TeamDavid before Rollout 528.

Starting with Rollout 528 (June 30, 2026), the affected functionality is disabled by default and the vulnerabilities are therefore no longer exposed through this functionality.
